channel_dna.platform_type: Private encrypted messaging apps with group functionality. WhatsApp dominates India, SEA, LatAm, MENA, Africa. Telegram dominant in crypto, developer, and Eastern European communities.
channel_dna.algorithm_type: No algorithm — real-time chronological. Discovery through: invite links shared in other platforms, word of mouth, community directories for Telegram. WhatsApp groups found via personal networks.
channel_dna.primary_audience: WhatsApp: India (600M+ users), Brazil, Southeast Asia, MENA, Africa — broad demographics. Telegram: Crypto communities, developer communities, startup ecosystems in emerging markets, privacy-focused users.
channel_dna.native_content_formats: Text messages, voice notes (very high engagement in WhatsApp), images, short videos, documents, polls (Telegram), bots (Telegram only). Voice notes are underutilised and extremely effective in WhatsApp.
channel_dna.platform_culture_code: WhatsApp is intimate — groups are trusted circles. Spam is severely punished (group removals). Value must be immediate and obvious. Telegram groups more public-facing, more tolerant of promotional content in designated channels. Both value personal, authentic communication.
channel_dna.account_warmup_requirements: WhatsApp: Must be invited into existing groups or create your own. No cold entry. Telegram: Can search and join public groups. Both require complete profile with professional photo.

fit_scoring_matrix.best_product_types: Products targeting Indian market (any category), edtech for emerging markets, fintech for developing markets, local services, B2B tools for SMBs in India/SEA/LatAm, community-building products
fit_scoring_matrix.worst_product_types: Products with no emerging market angle, enterprise B2B targeting Western corporations, products not relevant to mobile-first markets
fit_scoring_matrix.best_pricing_models: All pricing models work. Mobile-first markets often prefer lower price points. Freemium with clear value demonstration works best for conversion in trust-based communities.
fit_scoring_matrix.icp_match_signals: If your ICP is Indian, Southeast Asian, Brazilian, or from MENA/Africa — they are definitely on WhatsApp. If your ICP is in crypto, developer communities — they are on Telegram.
fit_scoring_matrix.red_flags_skip_this_channel: Skip if your ICP is exclusively Western professional (LinkedIn is better). Skip if your product has no mobile-first use case.
fit_scoring_matrix.geographic_strength: WhatsApp: India (dominant), Brazil, Indonesia, Nigeria, Mexico, Saudi Arabia. Telegram: Russia, Ukraine, Iran, crypto-global, developer-global.

growth_mechanics.expected_cac: $0 cash. Time cost: 1-2 hrs/day monitoring and engaging in 5-10 groups.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_traffic_spike: 1-2 weeks — WhatsApp word-of-mouth travels fast within tight communities.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_paying_user: 1-3 weeks in the right groups — trust is pre-established in community settings.
growth_mechanics.effort_level: Medium. Daily monitoring of key groups. Consistent, helpful participation. Building your own group if you have 50+ existing contacts to seed it.
growth_mechanics.virality_coefficient: Very High within network — WhatsApp shares spread virally through personal contacts. 'Forward to contacts' is a native behaviour. One viral message can reach thousands through cascaded forwards.
growth_mechanics.compounding_potential: Medium. Your own WhatsApp/Telegram community compounds well. Other groups give periodic exposure but not compounding.

algorithm_playbook.how_reach_is_determined: No algorithm. Real-time visibility based on: timing of messages (active group hours), quality of message (does it get replied to?), personal relationships in the group.
algorithm_playbook.what_algorithm_rewards: N/A. Real-time platform. Active groups have high message velocity — post during peak activity for visibility.
algorithm_playbook.what_kills_reach: Being removed from groups for spam. Sending broadcast messages to people who haven't opted in (WhatsApp blocks accounts for this). Over-promoting in community groups.
algorithm_playbook.peak_posting_windows: India: 9-11am IST and 8-10pm IST. LatAm: 8-10am and 7-9pm local. Match your target market's active hours.
algorithm_playbook.optimal_posting_cadence: 1-2 substantive posts per week in each group. Daily engagement in replies. Over-posting in groups = getting muted or removed.
algorithm_playbook.content_freshness_window: Messages disappear in active groups within hours. Voice notes have longer shelf-life (people listen later). Screenshot-able content (images with text) gets saved and reshared.

content_system.winning_content_types: 1. Useful resource share (PDF, guide, template) 2. Voice note with personal story or tip 3. Question to group (drives replies and visibility) 4. Image with key insight 5. Genuine offer of help for specific problems discussed in group
content_system.hook_formulas: Voice note: 'Quick voice note — wanted to share something that saved us 10 hours last week...' | Image post: '[Infographic with single key insight] — Thought this would be useful for the group.' | Question: 'Quick question for the group — how are you all handling [specific challenge]?'
content_system.platform_native_tone: Personal, warm, conversational. WhatsApp is intimate — write like you are texting a colleague, not broadcasting. Voice notes are extremely powerful — more personal than text. In India especially, professional WhatsApp communication is casual and direct.
content_system.cta_approach: Never hard sell in groups. Soft mentions: 'We built something to solve exactly this — if anyone wants to try it, DM me.' When asked directly about your solution: share clearly and directly. Build your own broadcast list for direct product updates to opted-in contacts.
content_system.content_to_avoid: Unsolicited broadcast messages to people who haven't opted in. Promotional content in groups that don't allow it. Forwarded messages (signals low-effort participation). Spamming group with repeated messages.
content_system.cross_posting_rules: WhatsApp content is not shareable to public platforms (private). Create content specifically for WhatsApp. Telegram public channels can be shared more broadly.

community_outreach_playbook.where_icp_clusters: WhatsApp: Founder groups (YourStory, Inc42 communities for India), industry-specific groups, alumni networks, local chamber of commerce groups. Telegram: Search your product category on Telegram. Telegram group directories at t.me/startups, t.me/indiehackers_chat.
community_outreach_playbook.contribution_before_pitch_rule: Be a genuine, helpful member for 2+ weeks before any product mention. WhatsApp groups are high-trust environments — self-promotion without established trust backfires severely.
community_outreach_playbook.dm_outreach_approach: WhatsApp personal DMs are extremely high-converting when warm. After someone in a group mentions the problem you solve: 'Hey [Name], saw your message in [group] about [problem]. We actually built something for exactly this — would be happy to show you. No pressure.'
community_outreach_playbook.influencer_partner_strategy: Group admins are gatekeepers and influencers. Build relationship with admins before promoting. Offer something valuable to the group (a free workshop, resource) — admin will facilitate the promotion.
community_outreach_playbook.broadcast_vs_community_mode: Community mode in groups. Broadcast mode only via WhatsApp Broadcast Lists to people who have opted in or are existing contacts.
community_outreach_playbook.banned_behaviours: Sending unsolicited messages to people who have not interacted with you. Adding people to groups without permission. Sharing misleading information. Spamming groups with identical promotional messages.

business_stage_playbook.pre_launch_0_users: Join relevant WhatsApp/Telegram groups where your ICP hangs out. Post problem statement to validate demand. Build personal relationships with potential beta users via DM.
business_stage_playbook.early_traction_1_to_100: Create a WhatsApp Community or Telegram channel for your product's early users — personal, high-touch onboarding via chat is a significant retention advantage in emerging markets.
business_stage_playbook.growth_100_to_1k: WhatsApp Business API for broadcast to opted-in users. Build Telegram channel for public-facing updates and product announcements. Partner with established community groups for featured posts.
business_stage_playbook.scale_1k_plus: WhatsApp Business API for large-scale opted-in messaging. Telegram bot for product interactions. Build community of 1K+ members in your own WhatsApp/Telegram group.

proof_of_play.early_stage_win: Khatabook (India) — digital ledger for small businesses built initial user base almost entirely through WhatsApp community marketing. Shopkeepers shared the app through existing WhatsApp merchant groups. Zero paid ads in early growth.
proof_of_play.growth_stage_win: CRED (India) — used WhatsApp for high-touch user onboarding and credit card payment reminders. The personal feel of WhatsApp communication drove 90%+ onboarding completion rates.
proof_of_play.what_made_it_work: Both met their Indian ICP exactly where they were — on WhatsApp. The intimate, personal channel was perfectly matched to the trust-based nature of the product relationships.
proof_of_play.what_would_have_killed_it: Treating WhatsApp as a broadcast channel for promotional messages would have resulted in mass reporting and account suspension.
